notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower-specific source is one row in the tnlandforms Georgia list: name, coordinates, county, elevation 501 (no unit given; read as feet this matches the 152.7 m in the record), and two codes, BLL-50812 and gfc-620. The list's own description of its fields reads 'lat/lon, elevation, GFC number', next to a link to the Georgia Forestry Commission, which supports reading gfc-620 as a Georgia Forestry Commission number. No source read or searched explains the BLL code, so the story says only that the list carries it. Nothing found gives a build date, staffing, fire history, fate or access. Searches for a Wrens fire tower returned only the Chenocetah tower (Habersham County, GA) and Jefferson County, Alabama towers (Rock Mountain, Wharton), which are different structures. The Georgia Forest Fire Lookout Association chapter reports in the cache (2013) and the Georgia/SC reports do not name Wrens. The cached NHLR Georgia index does not list a Wrens tower. Verification pass 2026-10-21: flagged the missing elevation unit; replaced 'BLL number' with 'a code ... that the list does not explain'; changed 'the town's Wikipedia entry' to 'the Wikipedia article'; added the GFC field-description quote. The brief's county, coordinates and elevation match the list.
